overview.purpose_zh: 用连线展示一个共用支付服务和各页面之间的上下级关系，重点是哪些页面依赖它，而不是给页面排名。
works_zh: 适合展示组织结构、目录和依赖关系
适合说明一个服务出问题时会影响哪些页面
uses_zh: 技术方案评审里的依赖说明
故障复盘时讲清影响范围

understanding.read_zh: 从根节点 Payments API 出发，先看三个分支，再看每个分支下的页面。节点大小是用量，连线才表示依赖；读这棵树先问“谁连着谁”，再问“各有多少人”。

elements.note_zh: 树的最上层是 Payments API，所有分支都从它展开。
Orders、Subscriptions 和 Wallet 是三条业务线，各自挂着一组页面。
每个具体页面都是叶子，数字是它每天使用支付服务的人数。
连线表示调用关系，没有连线就没有依赖，和人数多少无关。

look_for_zh: 根节点下面有几个分支
每个分支里哪个页面用得最多

observations.en: Every screen in the chart is a child of the Payments API root, so the tree shows one shared dependency rather than separate services.
observations.zh: 图上的每个页面都是 Payments API 根节点的子节点，所以这棵树展示的是一个共用依赖，而不是彼此独立的服务。

observations.en: Orders sends 100 users a day through the service, the heaviest branch, followed by Subscriptions at 56 and Wallet at 41.
observations.zh: Orders 每天有 100 名用户经过这个服务，是最重的分支，其后是 Subscriptions 的 56 和 Wallet 的 41。

observations.en: Checkout is the busiest single screen at 42 users a day, and Cart checkout follows at 31.
observations.zh: Checkout 是最忙的单个页面，每天 42 名用户，Cart checkout 以 31 紧随其后。

observations.en: Cancel and refund is the lightest screen at 8 users a day, just under a fifth of Checkout's 42.
observations.zh: Cancel and refund 是最轻的页面，每天 8 名用户，略低于 Checkout 42 人的五分之一。

observations.en: Wallet's three screens together reach 41 users a day, with Payment methods at 17, Receipts at 13 and Top up at 11.
observations.zh: Wallet 的三个页面合计每天触达 41 名用户，其中 Payment methods 17、Receipts 13、Top up 11。

observations.en: Even Order history, the smallest Orders screen, handles 9 users a day.
observations.zh: 即使是 Orders 里最小的页面 Order history，每天也处理 9 名用户。

describe.en: The tree illustrates which screens call the Payments API and how they sit under three business lines.
describe.zh: 这棵树说明哪些页面在调用 Payments API，以及它们如何分属三条业务线。
describe.pattern: The tree illustrates + how / which + clause
alternatives: The diagram shows the screens that depend on the Payments API.
It maps the links between one service and its callers.
describe.note_zh: illustrate 适合解释结构，不适合说数量变化。

describe.en: Overall, the tree has one root and three branches, so every screen depends on the same service.
describe.zh: 总体来看，这棵树有一个根节点和三个分支，所以每个页面都依赖同一个服务。
alternatives: In general, the chart shows a single shared dependency.
All three branches meet at the same root.
describe.note_zh: overall 放句首时后面加逗号，用来先给结构上的总结。

describe.en: The three branches reach 100, 56 and 41 users a day respectively.
describe.zh: 三个分支每天分别触达 100、56 和 41 名用户。
describe.pattern: A, B and C + verb + X, Y and Z + respectively
alternatives: Orders reaches 100 users a day, Subscriptions 56 and Wallet 41.
The daily reach of the three branches is 100, 56 and 41.
describe.note_zh: respectively 要求三个数字按前面名称的顺序排列。

describe.en: The root is followed by Orders, Subscriptions and Wallet, and each branch is followed by its screens.
describe.zh: 根节点下面依次是 Orders、Subscriptions 和 Wallet，每个分支下面再接着它的各个页面。
alternatives: Payments API is followed by three branches.
Each branch is followed by its own screens.
describe.note_zh: 树图里的 followed by 表示层级上的下一层，不是时间顺序。

describe.en: Checkout alone handles 42 users a day, nearly half of the 100 in Orders.
describe.zh: 仅 Checkout 一个页面每天就处理 42 名用户，接近 Orders 分支 100 人的一半。
alternatives: Checkout accounts for almost half of the Orders branch.
At 42 users a day, Checkout is close to half of 100.
describe.note_zh: nearly half 表示接近一半但没到，42 对 100 正好合适。

describe.en: What stands out is the reach of a single service: every screen hangs under one root.
describe.zh: 最突出的是一个服务的覆盖面：所有页面都挂在同一个根节点下。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun phrase
alternatives: The most striking point is how many screens share one dependency.
describe.note_zh: 这句话的重点是依赖范围，不是页面之间的排名。

academic.en: The tree maps the dependency of the product screens on one shared payments service. The root, Payments API, has three children: Orders, Subscriptions and Wallet. Orders is the heaviest branch at 100 users a day, followed by Subscriptions at 56 and Wallet at 41. Within Orders, Checkout accounts for 42 users, Cart checkout for 31, One-tap pay for 18 and Order history for 9. Subscriptions splits into Start subscription at 26, Renewal at 22 and Cancel and refund at 8. Wallet contains Payment methods at 17, Receipts at 13 and Top up at 11. Reach and structural position are encoded by the links, while node size is secondary.
academic.zh: 这棵树刻画了各个产品页面对一个共用支付服务的依赖。根节点 Payments API 有三个子节点：Orders、Subscriptions 和 Wallet。Orders 是最重的分支，每天 100 名用户，其后是 Subscriptions 的 56 和 Wallet 的 41。Orders 内部，Checkout 为 42 名用户，Cart checkout 31，One-tap pay 18，Order history 9。Subscriptions 分为 Start subscription 26、Renewal 22 和 Cancel and refund 8。Wallet 包含 Payment methods 17、Receipts 13 和 Top up 11。连线表示触达范围和结构位置，节点大小是次要的。

business.en: One service sits behind every screen in our product, and the daily audience touches every part of it. Payments API is the shared dependency under Orders at 100 users a day, Subscriptions at 56 and Wallet at 41. Our real risk is concentration: Checkout alone brings 42 users through the service and Cart checkout adds another 31. If that service fails, we can read off exactly which screens go dark, from One-tap pay at 18 down to Cancel and refund at 8. We should put a backup and an alert on that service before the next release.
business.zh: 一个服务支撑我们产品里的每个页面，每天的用户遍布各处。Payments API 是共用依赖：Orders 每天 100 名用户，Subscriptions 56，Wallet 41。我们真正的风险在集中度：仅 Checkout 就带 42 名用户经过这个服务，Cart checkout 再加 31。如果这个服务出故障，我们能准确读出哪些页面会停摆，从 One-tap pay 的 18 到 Cancel and refund 的 8。我们应在下次发布前给这个服务加上备份和告警。

simple.en: This tree shows one payments service and the screens that use it. The service sits at the top. Three teams sit under it: Orders, Subscriptions and Wallet. Orders has the most people, 100 a day. Subscriptions has 56 and Wallet has 41. Checkout is the busiest screen at 42 users a day. Cancel and refund is the smallest at 8. The lines show who needs the service, not who is best.
simple.zh: 这棵树展示一个支付服务和用到它的页面。服务在最上面。下面有三个团队：Orders、Subscriptions 和 Wallet。Orders 的人最多，每天 100。Subscriptions 是 56，Wallet 是 41。Checkout 是最忙的页面，每天 42 名用户。Cancel and refund 最小，只有 8。连线表示谁需要这个服务，不是谁最好。

language_notes.body_zh: 树图用 root 表示共用服务，parent 表示上一层，child 表示依赖它的下一层。说依赖关系时常用 call 或 depend on，而不是 rank。
examples: Every screen calls the Payments API.
Orders is a child of Payments API.

language_notes.body_zh: 节点大小是使用人数，连线才表示结构。不要把树读成排行榜：一个很小的页面，仍然可能和最大的页面依赖同一个根节点。
examples: Checkout is the largest node at 42 users a day.
Top up has only 11 users but still depends on the same root.

language_notes.body_zh: 说这棵树时，重点用 reach 或 depend on，而不是 best 或 most important。图回答的是“哪些页面受影响”，不是“哪个页面最好”。
examples: Orders reaches 100 users a day through four screens.
The tree shows which screens depend on the service.
